title: Zscaler Cellular Dashboard: what each widget shows and where its numbers link

prose.text: The Zscaler Cellular Dashboard summarizes the organization's SIMs and their data usage in widgets; the SIM inventory behind its links is in [[zscaler-cellular.sims]].

prose.label: SIM counts.
prose.text: {{total-and-used-sims}} {{state-overview}} What counts as active is unsettled {{divergence:active-meaning}}.

prose.label: Usage.
prose.text: {{total-usage-graph}} {{top-10-sims}} {{top-20-countries}} Retention and the longest custom date range are open {{gap:dashboard-range-limits}}.

total-and-used-sims.statement: The Zscaler Cellular Dashboard (Infrastructure > Cellular > Dashboard) has a Total SIMs widget showing the number of SIM cards provisioned for the organization, and clicking its number opens the SIMs page listing all of them; its Used SIMs widget shows the number the page describes as actively transmitting data, and clicking that number opens the SIMs page with Status set to Active.

quotes: The Zscaler Cellular Dashboard (Infrastructure > Cellular > Dashboard)
- Total SIMs
This widget displays the total number of SIM cards provisioned for your organization.
You can click the numerical value representing the number of SIMs to go the SIMs page and see all SIM cards provisioned for the organization.
- Used SIMs
You can click the numerical value representing the number of used SIMs to go the SIMs page with appropriate filters applied.
This widget shows the number of SIM cards that are actively transmitting data.
When you click the numerical value, the SIMs page displays with the Status parameter set to Active, ensuring that only the SIMs cards that are active are displayed.

state-overview.statement: The SIMs State Overview widget categorizes SIMs as Activated (currently active and in use) or Inactive (not in use or deactivated); clicking the Activated number opens the SIMs page with Status set to Active, and clicking the Inactive number opens it with Status set to Inactive.

quotes: - SIMs State Overview
It categorizes SIMs into the following statuses:
You can click the numerical value representing the number of inactive SIMs to go the SIMs page to see all SIM cards that are currently inactive.

Activated: The number of SIM cards currently active and in use. You can click the numerical value representing the number of active SIMs to go the SIMs page to see all SIM cards that are currently active.
the SIMs page is displayed by applying the filter with the Status parameter set to Active, ensuring that only the SIMs cards that are active are displayed.
Inactive: The number of SIM cards that are not in use or have been deactivated.
set to Inactive, ensuring that only the SIMs cards that are inactive are displayed

global-map.statement: The Global Map widget shows the geographical distribution of active SIM cards on a world map with country granularity, a blue dot for active connections in a region.

quotes: - Global Map
This widget displays the geographical distribution of active SIM cards on a world map with country granularity.
Each blue dot represents active connections in a specific region

total-usage-graph.statement: The Total Usage Graph widget shows daily data usage trends over the selected period as a line and bar graph, with the cumulative usage of all SIM cards in the range. The range is a default (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Last Month) or custom start and end dates, and the graph data downloads as SVG, PNG or CSV.

quotes: This widget shows data usage as a line and bar graph showing daily data usage trends over the selected period.
In the top-left corner of this widget, the cumulative data usage for all SIM cards within the selected date range is shown
selecting a default range (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, or Last Month) or selecting start and end dates for a custom range
select a download option based on the preferred format (Download as SVG, Download as PNG, or Download as CSV)

top-10-sims.statement: The Usage by top 10 SIMs widget shows the 10 SIMs with the highest data consumption within the selected date range, each identified by its unique number, as a bar chart; like the Total Usage Graph it has a default or custom date range and downloads as SVG, PNG or CSV.

quotes: This widget displays the top 10 SIMs with the highest data consumption within the selected date range.
Each SIM is identified by its unique number, and its corresponding data usage is visualized as a bar chart.
You can customize the date range by selecting a default range (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, or Last Month) or selecting start and end dates for a custom range.

To download the graph data for the specified date range, click the Menu icon in the top-right corner of the graph, and select a download option based on the preferred format (Download as SVG, Download as PNG, or Download as CSV).

top-20-countries.statement: The Usage by top 20 Countries widget shows data consumption for the 20 countries where the SIMs consumed the most data within the selected period; like the Total Usage Graph it has a default or custom date range and downloads as SVG, PNG or CSV.

quotes: highlighting the top 20 countries where the SIMs have consumed the most data within the selected period
You can customize the date range by selecting a default range (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, or Last Month) or selecting start and end dates for a custom range.

To download the graph data for the specified date range, click the Menu icon in the top-right corner of the graph, and select a download option based on the preferred format (Download as SVG, Download as PNG, or Download as CSV).

active-meaning.summary: The dashboard defines Used SIMs as actively transmitting data and Activated as active and in use, yet both link to the SIMs page filtered on Status Active, which the SIMs page defines as available for use.

quotes: This widget shows the number of SIM cards that are actively transmitting data.
When you click the numerical value, the SIMs page displays with the Status parameter set to Active, ensuring that only the SIMs cards that are active are displayed.

positions.says: Used SIMs counts SIMs actively transmitting data, and its link lists the SIMs with Status Active.

quotes: Status: The operational state of the SIM, either Active (available for use) or Inactive (not in use).

positions.says: Status Active means available for use, not transmitting.

active-meaning.impact: The list behind a Used SIMs or Activated number may not match the count; which definition the count follows is not settled by the documentation.

dashboard-range-limits.title: Dashboard data retention, maximum custom date range and the time window behind Used SIMs
dashboard-range-limits.detail: The dashboard article states the default and custom date ranges but no retention period or maximum custom range, and does not define a time window for a SIM counting as actively transmitting data. Cellular log retention generally is in shared.logs-fair-use.log-retention:cellular, but no source maps those logs to the dashboard.
